title: Cattaneo 2010 · Number priming and haptic bisection
citation: Cattaneo et al. (2010). Crossmodal interaction between the mental number line and peripersonal haptic space representation in sighted and blind individuals. Attention, Perception, & Psychophysics, 72(4), 885–890.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.apparatus: Four fixed wooden rods of 300, 350, 400 or 450 mm, 14 mm diameter, centered on the body midline with midpoint approximately 380 mm from midsternum.
published_method.audio: Prerecorded female voice saying 2, 8 or ‘blah’, starting with rod exploration. Digit trains use ten repetitions at approximately one per second. Exact control token count unreported.
published_method.procedure: Start with the right palm at about the midpoint. Explore with the right index for 10 s and indicate the estimated midpoint. Experimenter records position to nearest mm and initial scan direction.
published_method.outcome: Signed midpoint error as a percentage of half-length and initially explored direction.

value.pre: Experimenter places right palm over rod midpoint, with possible small offsets either way.
value.start: Lift palm and begin exploring with right index finger as audio starts.
value.during: Scan in preferred initial direction. Repeated traversals allowed within 10 s.
value.response: At scan end, indicate estimated midpoint with right index finger.
value.record: Experimenter reads the roughly 1 mm fingertip mark, measures position to nearest mm, and logs initial scan direction.
